name: Hatarakanai Honey Life
original_name: ハタラカナイはにーらいふ
source:
This is the first title by LimeCat. The protagonist is proud of being completely ordinary, but this summer his life has been turned upside-down. This was because his four childhood friends had shut themselves in his home!

After two years of being hikikomoris, their parents finally had enough and gave them the choice of finding a part-time job or being sent off to do manual labour for distant relatives. Of course, they chose the former, which was a government program to help hikikomoris return to normal. He was entrusted with helping them for the duration of the summer vacation. He hoped to fulfill their parents’ requests and to help them return to how they were before. At the same time, they all came to him since they held secret feelings for him. Thus begins their summer days together breaking free from NEET.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/06/07/june-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
这是LimeCat的第一个作品。主角以自己的平凡而自豪，但今年夏天他的生活发生了翻天覆地的变化。因为他的四个青梅竹马，都把自己关在家里了！

两年的“蛰居”生活，父母终于受够了，让他们选择是找一份兼职，还是被送去给远方亲戚做体力活。当然，他们选择了前者，这是政府帮助蛰居族恢复正常生活的计划。他被委托在暑假期间帮助他们。他希望满足父母的要求，帮助他们回到以前的样子。与此同时，他们都来找他，因为他们对他怀有秘密的感情。就这样，他们开始了摆脱NEET束缚的夏日时光。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/06/07/june-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
